name: Barrier Capacitor
description: Soaks the first hits of a battle so the pilot lives long enough to earn the rest.

name: Thruster Pack
description: Extra burn for both the battlefield and the map — the difference between dodging and not.

name: Static Veil
description: Fuzzes enemy targeting solutions just enough to matter.

name: Tender Drone
description: A palm-sized drone that stitches armor plate back together mid-fight, badly but quickly.

name: Long Ear Array
description: Wide-band sensors that turn a guess of a forecast into something close to certainty.

name: Cradle Seat
description: A reinforced cockpit shell built around one promise: the pilot gets out even if the frame doesn't.

name: Reactive Plating
description: Bolt-on hull plating — heavy, ugly, and exactly what you want between you and a railgun.

name: Sightline Suite
description: Overlay optics that shave the guesswork off every shot.

name: Deep Tank
description: An extra reservoir that keeps a squad in the field long after the rest are limping home.

name: Compact Aegis Shell
description: Compact shield tech, generations ahead of anything Relay salvage can match.
